kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتدل (form VIII)
# أَعْتَدِلُ (ʔaʕtadilu) /ʔaʕ.ta.di.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# أَعْتَدِلَ (ʔaʕtadila) /ʔaʕ.ta.di.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# أَعْتَدِلْ (ʔaʕtadil) /ʔaʕ.ta.dil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
